mapper.select: SELECT id, scenario_id, keyword, weight, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM scenario_keyword WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} ORDER BY weight DESC, keyword
SELECT id, scenario_id, keyword, weight, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM scenario_keyword WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY weight DESC, keyword

SELECT k.id, k.scenario_id, k.keyword, k.weight, k.enabled, k.created_at, k.updated_at FROM scenario_keyword k JOIN scenario s ON s.id = k.scenario_id JOIN scenario_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.active_version_id IS NOT NULL AND c.enabled = TRUE AND k.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY k.scenario_id, k.weight DESC, k.keyword
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scenario_keyword (scenario_id, keyword, weight, enabled) VALUES (#{scenarioId}, #{keyword}, #{weight}, #{enabled})
